description: Kotlin coroutine client for the MisarReach outreach and lead-generation API: asynchronous lead search across 23 sources, streamed live as a Flow of Server-Sent Events; CRM contacts, deals and a Kanban pipeline; multi-step email, SMS, WhatsApp, web-push and social-DM campaigns; AI sales agent, autopilot, deliverability and plan quotas. 17 resource groups covering all 94 REST operations as suspend functions over JSON maps, Bearer mrk_ auth, exponential-backoff retries on 429/500/502/503/504, and a typed 402 plan-cap refusal naming the exhausted counter. JVM 17+.
